levels.title: Build the scouting roster (CREATE TABLE)
levels.task: Stellar Sound is launching a new-artist scouting program and the database is empty. Create the new_artists table with the following columns: id, name, genre, country, signed_date. Use your best judgement for the data types.
levels.initialCode:
CREATE TABLE new_artists (...);

SELECT * FROM new_artists;
levels.solution: CREATE TABLE new_artists (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, genre TEXT, country TEXT, signed_date DATE);
levels.hintMessage: Use CREATE TABLE name (col TYPE, col TYPE, ...);. Don't forget to add your primary key column.

levels.title: Sign one new artist (INSERT one row)
levels.task: A&R just signed a new pop artist out of the United States. Add ONE row to new_artists with id 1, name 'Echo Park', genre 'Pop', country 'United States', signed_date '2026-06-01'.
levels.solution:
INSERT INTO new_artists (id, name, genre, country, signed_date) VALUES (1, 'Echo Park', 'Pop', 'United States', '2026-06-01');
SELECT * FROM new_artists;
levels.hintMessage: Use quotes around text and date values. List the columns inside the INSERT in the same order as the VALUES.
levels.successMessage: Great! Echo Park is officially on the roster.

levels.title: Showcase signing (INSERT multiple rows)
levels.task:
After Friday's showcase, three artists signed within a week. Insert all three into new_artists in a SINGLE INSERT statement (one INSERT, multiple VALUES rows). 
Artist 2: River Lights, Indie, Cambodia, 2026-06-15
Artist 3: Crown Heights, Hip-Hop, England, 2026-06-18
Artist 4: Luna Ray, R&B, Australia, 2026-06-20
levels.hintMessage: One INSERT can add many rows at once, separated by commas: INSERT INTO t (cols) VALUES (...), (...), (...);. Don't forget single quotes around text and dates.
levels.successMessage: Perfect! All three showcase signings are in the system.

levels.title: Move an artist's home base (UPDATE)
levels.task: Echo Park (id 1) just moved from the United States to Mexico. Change her country to 'Mexico'. End with: SELECT id, name, country FROM new_artists WHERE id = 1;
levels.hintMessage: ALWAYS include a WHERE with an UPDATE statement. Without it, every row in the table changes, so filter on id = 1.
levels.successMessage: Got it — Echo Park's profile now shows Mexico.

levels.title: Close the Australian branch (DELETE)
levels.task: Stellar Sound is closing its Australian office and dropping every artist signed there. DELETE all rows from new_artists who live in Australia.
levels.initialCode:
DELETE FROM new_artists WHERE ...;

SELECT * FROM new_artists;
levels.solution:
DELETE FROM new_artists WHERE country = 'Australia';

SELECT * FROM new_artists;
levels.hintMessage: Same warning as UPDATE: a DELETE with no WHERE empties the whole table. Filter on country = 'Australia'.
